# Vendored browser assets

- **Preact 10.29.8** — MIT — <https://unpkg.com/preact@10.29.8/>
  - `preact.module.js`
  - `hooks.module.js`
  - License: `PREACT-LICENSE`
- **htm 3.1.1** — Apache-2.0 — <https://unpkg.com/htm@3.1.1/>

These files are served directly by `niunexus-web` through an import map; there is no Node/npm build step.
